description: This file defines the AuthGate widget to handle authentication state navigation and the main tab navigation interface shown after signing in. It includes a widget that listens to authentication state and conditionally displays either sign-in or main tabs, along with a StatefulWidget managing bottom navigation among various pages such as Tasks, Projects, Tags, Dashboard, and Settings.

classes.name: AuthGate
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that listens to authentication state and displays either the sign-in page or main tabs.

classes.name: _MainTabsPage
classes.description: A StatefulWidget managing the bottom navigation bar and the corresponding page content.

classes.name: _MainTabsPageState
classes.description: State class for _MainTabsPage, maintaining current tab index and providing the tab content and navigation logic.

classes.name: _TabInfo
classes.description: A simple data class holding information about each tab (title, icon, and content).

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for AuthGate or the main tabs interface based on auth state, or for _MainTabsPageState managing the main tabs.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the _MainTabsPage widget.
